_doc: Decision 4 (4 Nov): map each teacher-sheet SOURCE FILE (Drive file id = the .xlsx basename in data/source/sheets/) to an existing teacher slug in data/source/teachers-2026-11-02/. The teacher is taken from this map, NOT from the sheet cell. A file with no entry here is UNMAPPED: catalogue-build lists it and hides its courses — slugs are NEVER guessed. The 13 non-pilot entries were confirmed by the coordinator (5 Nov) by surname against the teacher data; 3 files remain unmapped because no teacher record exists for them; they are listed in "pending" below: catalogue-build hides their lessons as PENDING TEACHER and does not fail. Any unmapped file NOT in "pending" is an ERROR and fails the catalogue job. When a teacher record exists, move the file id into "files" and delete it from "pending".
